name: Mustang Minerals Limited
summary: Mustang Minerals Limited acquires, explores and develops mineral resource properties in Mexico, exploring for silver, gold, copper, molybdenum and other precious metals. It holds a full interest in the El Cobre property, made up of nine mineral concessions in Veracruz. Formerly Azucar Minerals Ltd., it was incorporated in 2015 and has its base in Vancouver, Canada.
